commands.output:
- name: Apply dev infrastructure
  hosts: runner-01
  tasks:
    - name: Terraform init
      community.general.terraform:
        project_path: /opt/infra/terraform
        state: present
        backend_config:
          bucket: tfstate
        force_init: true
      environment:
        AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: "{{ lookup('env', 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID') }}"
        AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: "{{ lookup('env', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY') }}"

    - name: Select workspace
      ansible.builtin.command: terraform workspace select -or-create dev
      args:
        chdir: /opt/infra/terraform
      environment:
        AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: "{{ lookup('env', 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID') }}"
        AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: "{{ lookup('env', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY') }}"
